description: Single checker at point 20.  Die 5 → 20/15 open, then die 3 → 15/12 blocked (1 move). Die 3 → 20/17 open, then die 5 → 17/12 blocked (1 move). Both individually work, not together → must use larger die (5).
notes: Larger-die rule: when only 1 die can be used and both dice individually work, must use the larger (5, not 3). 12 is blocked.
